branchName.instructions: Branch from release, never from main. Short kebab-case describing the change, no type prefix: app-foundation, jev-live-session, folder-export.

commitMessage.instructions: One line, plain natural language, saying what the commit does. No conventional-commit prefixes, no body, no trailers, no tool or AI attribution of any kind. Commit small and often.

pullRequest.instructions: Base branch is always release. Title is one plain sentence. Body: one paragraph on what changed and why, one line saying which changeset was added (or why none: tests, tooling, refactor only), and how it was verified. No attribution or generated-by lines.
